import AVOC.CertificateLogic

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Binding

open Certificate

/-- Dependencies bind their declared formula and the exact retained artifact bytes. -/
structure Dependency where
  name : String
  statement : Formula
  artifactBytes : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Formal meaning and execution identity. Strings denote full byte snapshots in
this model, never an axiom that a finite hash is injective. -/
structure Identity where
  task : String
  statement : Formula
  statementBytes : String
  dependencies : List Dependency
  environment : List (String × String)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Artifact where
  identity : Identity
  sourceBytes : String
  proof : Derivation
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Generation distinguishes re-registration even of exactly the same payload. -/
structure Ticket where
  generation : Nat
  artifact : Artifact
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Receipt where
  subject : Ticket
  approved : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def context (i : Identity) : List Formula := i.dependencies.map Dependency.statement

def Valid (a : Artifact) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v (context a.identity) → Denote v a.identity.statement

/-- A persisted receipt is not trusted as proof. The data-only proof is rechecked. -/
def validate (current : Identity) (pending : Ticket) (r : Receipt) : Bool :=
  decide (pending.artifact.identity = current) &&
  decide (r.subject = pending) && r.approved &&
  Certificate.check (context current) current.statement pending.artifact.proof

theorem validate_iff (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt) :
    validate i t r = true ↔
      t.artifact.identity = i ∧ r.subject = t ∧ r.approved = true ∧
      Certificate.check (context i) i.statement t.artifact.proof = true := by
  simp only [validate, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, h₃⟩, h₄⟩; exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄⟩; exact ⟨⟨⟨h₁,h₂⟩,h₃⟩,h₄⟩

theorem validated_identity (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) : t.artifact.identity = i := (validate_iff i t r).1 h |>.1

theorem validated_receipt (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) : r.subject = t := (validate_iff i t r).1 h |>.2.1

theorem validated_proof (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) :
    Certificate.check (context i) i.statement t.artifact.proof = true :=
  (validate_iff i t r).1 h |>.2.2.2

theorem validated_sound (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v (context i)) :
    Denote v i.statement := Certificate.check_sound _ _ _ (validated_proof i t r h) v hc

theorem validated_artifact_valid (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) : Valid t.artifact := by
  intro v hc
  have heq := validated_identity i t r h
  simpa only [heq] using (validated_sound i t r h v (by simpa only [heq] using hc))

theorem stale_identity_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity ≠ i) : validate i t r = false := by simp [validate, h]

theorem substituted_ticket_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : r.subject ≠ t) : validate i t r = false := by simp [validate, h]

theorem failed_proof_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : Certificate.check (context i) i.statement t.artifact.proof = false) :
    validate i t r = false := by simp [validate, h]

theorem generation_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : r.subject.generation ≠ t.generation) : validate i t r = false :=
  substituted_ticket_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Ticket.generation he))

theorem proof_bytes_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : r.subject.artifact.sourceBytes ≠ t.artifact.sourceBytes) :
    validate i t r = false :=
  substituted_ticket_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg (fun t => t.artifact.sourceBytes) he))

theorem target_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity.statement ≠ i.statement) : validate i t r = false :=
  stale_identity_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Identity.statement he))

theorem environment_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity.environment ≠ i.environment) : validate i t r = false :=
  stale_identity_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Identity.environment he))

theorem dependency_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity.dependencies ≠ i.dependencies) : validate i t r = false :=
  stale_identity_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Identity.dependencies he))

structure Slot where
  nextGeneration : Nat
  pending : Option Ticket
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def register (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) : Slot :=
  ⟨s.nextGeneration + 1, some ⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩⟩

def WellFormed (s : Slot) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, s.pending = some t → t.generation < s.nextGeneration

/-- A failed validation leaves the pending candidate untouched; success consumes it. -/
def consume (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) : Slot × Option Ticket :=
  match s.pending with
  | none => (s, none)
  | some t => if validate i t r then (⟨s.nextGeneration, none⟩, some t) else (s, none)

theorem register_pending (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) :
    (register s a).pending = some ⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩ := rfl

theorem register_wellFormed (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) : WellFormed (register s a) := by
  intro t ht
  have he : (⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩ : Ticket) = t := Option.some.inj ht
  subst t
  exact Nat.lt_succ_self _

theorem admission_iff (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket) :
    (consume s i r).2 = some t ↔ s.pending = some t ∧ validate i t r = true := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simp [consume, hp]
  | some u =>
      by_cases he : u = t
      · subst t
        by_cases hv : validate i u r = true <;> simp [consume, hp, hv]
      · by_cases hv : validate i u r = true <;> simp [consume, hp, he, hv]

theorem admission_consumes (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = some t) : (consume s i r).1.pending = none := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hv⟩ := (admission_iff s i r t).1 h
  simp [consume, hp, hv]

theorem admission_sound (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = some t) : Valid t.artifact :=
  validated_artifact_valid i t r ((admission_iff s i r t).1 h).2

theorem no_pending_no_admission (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt)
    (h : s.pending = none) : (consume s i r).2 = none := by simp [consume, h]

theorem successful_receipt_not_replayable (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = some t) : (consume (consume s i r).1 i r).2 = none :=
  no_pending_no_admission _ i r (admission_consumes s i r t h)

theorem old_pending_rejected_after_register (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) (i : Identity)
    (r : Receipt) (hs : WellFormed s) (hr : s.pending = some r.subject) :
    (consume (register s a) i r).2 = none := by
  have hlt := hs _ hr
  have hne : r.subject.generation ≠ s.nextGeneration := Nat.ne_of_lt hlt
  have hv := generation_mismatch_rejected i ⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩ r hne
  simp [consume, register, hv]

theorem consume_preserves_generation (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) :
    (consume s i r).1.nextGeneration = s.nextGeneration := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simp [consume, hp]
  | some t => by_cases hv : validate i t r = true <;> simp [consume, hp, hv]

theorem rejected_admission_unchanged (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = none) : (consume s i r).1 = s := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simp [consume, hp]
  | some t =>
      by_cases hv : validate i t r = true
      · simp [consume, hp, hv] at h
      · simp [consume, hp, hv]

theorem consume_preserves_wellFormed (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt)
    (hs : WellFormed s) : WellFormed (consume s i r).1 := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simpa [consume, hp] using hs
  | some t =>
      by_cases hv : validate i t r = true
      · intro u hu
        simp [consume, hp, hv] at hu
      · simpa [consume, hp, hv] using hs

end Komorebi.AVOC.Binding

import AVOC.ArtifactBinding
import AVOC.CertificateCodec

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Binding
open Lean Certificate

/-- Wire format uses explicit arrays and exact source strings. Its dependency
formulas are provided by the orchestrator after recursively checking their
snapshots. That filesystem connection remains a stated trusted boundary. -/
def parseDependency (j : Json) : Except String Dependency := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [name, statement, bytes] =>
      return ⟨← name.getStr?, ← parseFormula 64 statement, ← bytes.getStr?⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid dependency record"

def parseEnvironmentItem (j : Json) : Except String (String × String) := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [name, bytes] => return (← name.getStr?, ← bytes.getStr?)
  | _ => .error "invalid environment record"

def parseIdentity (j : Json) : Except String Identity := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [task, statement, bytes, .arr deps, .arr env] =>
      return ⟨← task.getStr?, ← parseFormula 64 statement, ← bytes.getStr?,
        ← deps.toList.mapM parseDependency, ← env.toList.mapM parseEnvironmentItem⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid identity record"

/-- The proof object is obtained from the exact source string held in the artifact. -/
def artifactFromSource (i : Identity) (bytes : String) : Except String Artifact :=
  match Json.parse bytes with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok j => match parseDerivation 128 j with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok p => .ok ⟨i, bytes, p⟩

theorem source_artifact_consistent (i : Identity) (bytes : String) (a : Artifact)
    (h : artifactFromSource i bytes = .ok a) :
    a.identity = i ∧ a.sourceBytes = bytes ∧
      ∃ j, Json.parse bytes = .ok j ∧ parseDerivation 128 j = .ok a.proof := by
  cases hj : Json.parse bytes with
  | error e => simp [artifactFromSource, hj] at h
  | ok j =>
      cases hp : parseDerivation 128 j with
      | error e => simp [artifactFromSource, hj, hp] at h
      | ok p =>
          have he : (⟨i,bytes,p⟩ : Artifact) = a := by simpa [artifactFromSource, hj, hp] using h
          subst a
          exact ⟨rfl,rfl,j,rfl,hp⟩

theorem source_artifact_checked_sound (i : Identity) (bytes : String) (a : Artifact)
    (h : artifactFromSource i bytes = .ok a)
    (hc : Certificate.check (context i) i.statement a.proof = true) :
    a.sourceBytes = bytes ∧ ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v (context i) → Denote v i.statement :=
  ⟨(source_artifact_consistent i bytes a h).2.1,
    fun v hv => Certificate.check_sound _ _ _ hc v hv⟩

def parseArtifact (j : Json) : Except String Artifact := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [identity, source] =>
      let i ← parseIdentity identity
      let bytes ← source.getStr?
      artifactFromSource i bytes
  | _ => .error "invalid artifact record"

def parseTicket (j : Json) : Except String Ticket := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [generation, artifact] => return ⟨← generation.getNat?, ← parseArtifact artifact⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid ticket"

def parseSlot (j : Json) : Except String Slot := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [next, .null] => return ⟨← next.getNat?, none⟩
  | [next, ticket] => return ⟨← next.getNat?, some (← parseTicket ticket)⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid slot"

def parseReceipt (j : Json) : Except String Receipt := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [ticket, .bool approved] => return ⟨← parseTicket ticket, approved⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid receipt"

def parseBoundRequest (j : Json) : Except String (Identity × Slot × Receipt) := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [.str "bound", identity, slot, receipt] =>
      return (← parseIdentity identity, ← parseSlot slot, ← parseReceipt receipt)
  | _ => .error "invalid binding request"

def checkBoundJson (j : Json) : Except String Bool :=
  match parseBoundRequest j with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok (i,s,r) => .ok ((consume s i r).2.isSome)

/-- The executed binding gate has both an exact pending subject and a sound
proof at every successful parse/check result. -/
theorem accepted_bound_json_has_evidence (j : Json) (h : checkBoundJson j = .ok true) :
    ∃ i s r t, parseBoundRequest j = .ok (i,s,r) ∧
      s.pending = some t ∧ r.subject = t ∧ t.artifact.identity = i ∧ Valid t.artifact := by
  cases hp : parseBoundRequest j with
  | error e => simp [checkBoundJson, hp] at h
  | ok data =>
      rcases data with ⟨i,s,r⟩
      have ha : (consume s i r).2.isSome = true := by simpa [checkBoundJson, hp] using h
      cases he : (consume s i r).2 with
      | none => simp [he] at ha
      | some t =>
          have hh := (admission_iff s i r t).1 he
          exact ⟨i,s,r,t,rfl,hh.1,validated_receipt i t r hh.2,
            validated_identity i t r hh.2,validated_artifact_valid i t r hh.2⟩

end Komorebi.AVOC.Binding

import AVOC.CertificateLogic
import Lean.Data.Json.Parser

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Certificate
open Lean

/-- Bounded, data-only decoding. This parser is part of the implementation trust
boundary; infer_sound applies to its resulting syntax objects. -/
def parseFormula : Nat → Json → Except String Formula
  | 0, _ => .error "formula depth limit"
  | n + 1, .arr a => match a.toList with
      | [.str "atom", k] => return .atom (← k.getNat?)
      | [.str "true"] => return .truth
      | [.str "false"] => return .falsity
      | [.str "and", p, q] => return .conj (← parseFormula n p) (← parseFormula n q)
      | [.str "or", p, q] => return .disj (← parseFormula n p) (← parseFormula n q)
      | [.str "imp", p, q] => return .impl (← parseFormula n p) (← parseFormula n q)
      | _ => .error "invalid formula tag or arity"
  | _, _ => .error "formula must be an array"

def parseDerivation : Nat → Json → Except String Derivation
  | 0, _ => .error "proof depth limit"
  | n + 1, .arr a => match a.toList with
      | [.str "hyp", f] => return .use (← parseFormula 64 f)
      | [.str "true"] => return .truth
      | [.str "pair", p, q] => return .pair (← parseDerivation n p) (← parseDerivation n q)
      | [.str "fst", p] => return .first (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "snd", p] => return .second (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "intro", f, p] => return .abstract (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "mp", p, q] => return .apply (← parseDerivation n p) (← parseDerivation n q)
      | [.str "left", f, p] => return .left (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "right", f, p] => return .right (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "cases", p, q, r] => return .cases (← parseDerivation n p) (← parseDerivation n q) (← parseDerivation n r)
      | [.str "absurd", f, p] => return .absurd (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | _ => .error "invalid proof tag or arity"
  | _, _ => .error "proof must be an array"

def parseRequest (j : Json) : Except String (Formula × List Formula × Derivation) := do
  let a ← j.getArr?
  match a.toList with
  | [target, .arr ctx, proof] =>
      let t ← parseFormula 64 target
      let c ← ctx.toList.mapM (parseFormula 64)
      let p ← parseDerivation 128 proof
      return (t, c, p)
  | _ => .error "expected [target, context-array, proof]"

def checkJson (j : Json) : Except String Bool :=
  match parseRequest j with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok (t,c,p) => .ok (check c t p)

/-- The exact decoded sequent behind any accepted JSON request is sound. -/
theorem accepted_json_has_sound_sequent (j : Json) (h : checkJson j = .ok true) :
    ∃ t c p, parseRequest j = .ok (t,c,p) ∧
      ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v c → Denote v t := by
  cases hp : parseRequest j with
  | error e => simp [checkJson, hp] at h
  | ok data =>
      rcases data with ⟨t,c,p⟩
      have hc : check c t p = true := by simpa [checkJson, hp] using h
      exact ⟨t,c,p,rfl,fun v hs => check_sound c t p hc v hs⟩

end Komorebi.AVOC.Certificate

import Std

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Certificate

/-- A deliberately small, data-only intuitionistic propositional language. -/
inductive Formula where
  | atom : Nat → Formula
  | truth : Formula
  | falsity : Formula
  | conj : Formula → Formula → Formula
  | disj : Formula → Formula → Formula
  | impl : Formula → Formula → Formula
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Atoms can denote arbitrary Lean propositions, not merely Boolean constants. -/
def Denote (v : Nat → Prop) : Formula → Prop
  | .atom n => v n
  | .truth => True
  | .falsity => False
  | .conj p q => Denote v p ∧ Denote v q
  | .disj p q => Denote v p ∨ Denote v q
  | .impl p q => Denote v p → Denote v q

def Satisfies (v : Nat → Prop) (ctx : List Formula) : Prop :=
  ∀ f ∈ ctx, Denote v f

/-- Proof syntax is data. No tactics, imports, macros, IO, or external code occur. -/
inductive Derivation where
  | use : Formula → Derivation
  | truth : Derivation
  | pair : Derivation → Derivation → Derivation
  | first : Derivation → Derivation
  | second : Derivation → Derivation
  | abstract : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  | apply : Derivation → Derivation → Derivation
  | left : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  | right : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  | cases : Derivation → Derivation → Derivation → Derivation
  | absurd : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def infer (ctx : List Formula) : Derivation → Option Formula
  | .use f => if f ∈ ctx then some f else none
  | .truth => some .truth
  | .pair p q => match infer ctx p, infer ctx q with
      | some f, some g => some (.conj f g)
      | _, _ => none
  | .first p => match infer ctx p with
      | some (.conj f _) => some f
      | _ => none
  | .second p => match infer ctx p with
      | some (.conj _ g) => some g
      | _ => none
  | .abstract f p => match infer (f :: ctx) p with
      | some g => some (.impl f g)
      | _ => none
  | .apply p q => match infer ctx p, infer ctx q with
      | some (.impl f g), some f' => if f = f' then some g else none
      | _, _ => none
  | .left g p => match infer ctx p with
      | some f => some (.disj f g)
      | _ => none
  | .right f p => match infer ctx p with
      | some g => some (.disj f g)
      | _ => none
  | .cases p q r => match infer ctx p with
      | some (.disj f g) => match infer (f :: ctx) q, infer (g :: ctx) r with
          | some h, some h' => if h = h' then some h else none
          | _, _ => none
      | _ => none
  | .absurd f p => match infer ctx p with
      | some .falsity => some f
      | _ => none

def check (ctx : List Formula) (target : Formula) (proof : Derivation) : Bool :=
  decide (infer ctx proof = some target)

theorem satisfies_cons (v : Nat → Prop) (ctx : List Formula) (f : Formula)
    (hf : Denote v f) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) : Satisfies v (f :: ctx) := by
  intro g hg
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hg with h | h
  · subst g; exact hf
  · exact hc g h

/-- Soundness is proved for the executable inference function itself. -/
theorem infer_sound (proof : Derivation) (ctx : List Formula) (target : Formula)
    (hi : infer ctx proof = some target) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) :
    Denote v target := by
  induction proof generalizing ctx target with
  | use f =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact hc _ ‹_›
      · contradiction
  | truth => cases hi; trivial
  | pair p q ihp ihq =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact ⟨ihp _ _ ‹_› hc, ihq _ _ ‹_› hc⟩
      · contradiction
  | first p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact (ih _ (.conj _ _) ‹_› hc).1
      · contradiction
  | second p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact (ih _ (.conj _ _) ‹_› hc).2
      · contradiction
  | abstract f p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi
        intro hf
        exact ih _ _ ‹_› (satisfies_cons v ctx f hf hc)
      · contradiction
  | apply p q ihp ihq =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · split at hi
        · rename_i heq
          subst heq
          cases hi
          exact (ihp _ (.impl _ _) ‹_› hc) (ihq _ _ ‹_› hc)
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
  | left g p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact Or.inl (ih _ _ ‹_› hc)
      · contradiction
  | right f p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact Or.inr (ih _ _ ‹_› hc)
      · contradiction
  | cases p q r ihp ihq ihr =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · split at hi
        · split at hi
          · rename_i heq
            subst heq
            cases hi
            rcases ihp _ (.disj _ _) ‹_› hc with hf | hg
            · exact ihq _ _ ‹_› (satisfies_cons v ctx _ hf hc)
            · exact ihr _ _ ‹_› (satisfies_cons v ctx _ hg hc)
          · contradiction
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
  | absurd f p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · exact False.elim (ih _ .falsity ‹_› hc)
      · contradiction

theorem check_sound (ctx : List Formula) (target : Formula) (proof : Derivation)
    (h : check ctx target proof = true) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) :
    Denote v target :=
  infer_sound proof ctx target (of_decide_eq_true h) v hc

theorem no_closed_false_proof (proof : Derivation) : check [] .falsity proof = false := by
  cases h : check [] .falsity proof with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
      have bad := check_sound [] .falsity proof h (fun _ => False)
        (by intro f hf; simp at hf)
      exact False.elim bad

theorem identity_checked (f : Formula) :
    check [] (.impl f f) (.abstract f (.use f)) = true := by
  simp [check, infer]

theorem premise_checked (ctx : List Formula) (f : Formula) (h : f ∈ ctx) :
    check ctx f (.use f) = true := by simp [check, infer, h]

theorem truth_checked (ctx : List Formula) : check ctx .truth .truth = true := rfl

theorem check_target_unique (ctx : List Formula) (p : Derivation) (f g : Formula)
    (hf : check ctx f p = true) (hg : check ctx g p = true) : f = g := by
  have h := (of_decide_eq_true hf).symm.trans (of_decide_eq_true hg)
  exact Option.some.inj h

/-- Sequential closure of a list of checked artifacts. Later claims can use only
already certified formulas, never a future or circular premise. -/
def CheckedChain : List Formula → List (Formula × Derivation) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | ctx, (f,p) :: rest => check ctx f p = true ∧ CheckedChain (f :: ctx) rest

def chainContext : List Formula → List (Formula × Derivation) → List Formula
  | ctx, [] => ctx
  | ctx, (f,_) :: rest => chainContext (f :: ctx) rest

theorem checked_chain_sound (ctx : List Formula) (xs : List (Formula × Derivation))
    (h : CheckedChain ctx xs) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) :
    Satisfies v (chainContext ctx xs) := by
  induction xs generalizing ctx with
  | nil => exact hc
  | cons item xs ih =>
      rcases item with ⟨f,p⟩
      exact ih _ h.2 (satisfies_cons v ctx f (check_sound ctx f p h.1 v hc) hc)

theorem closed_chain_sound (xs : List (Formula × Derivation))
    (h : CheckedChain [] xs) : ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v (chainContext [] xs) := by
  intro v
  exact checked_chain_sound [] xs h v (by intro f hf; simp at hf)

import AVOC.CertificateLogic

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Binding

open Certificate

/-- Dependencies bind their declared formula and the exact retained artifact bytes. -/
structure Dependency where
  name : String
  statement : Formula
  artifactBytes : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Formal meaning and execution identity. Strings denote full byte snapshots in
this model, never an axiom that a finite hash is injective. -/
structure Identity where
  task : String
  statement : Formula
  statementBytes : String
  dependencies : List Dependency
  environment : List (String × String)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Artifact where
  identity : Identity
  sourceBytes : String
  proof : Derivation
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Generation distinguishes re-registration even of exactly the same payload. -/
structure Ticket where
  generation : Nat
  artifact : Artifact
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Receipt where
  subject : Ticket
  approved : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def context (i : Identity) : List Formula := i.dependencies.map Dependency.statement

def Valid (a : Artifact) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v (context a.identity) → Denote v a.identity.statement

/-- A persisted receipt is not trusted as proof. The data-only proof is rechecked. -/
def validate (current : Identity) (pending : Ticket) (r : Receipt) : Bool :=
  decide (pending.artifact.identity = current) &&
  decide (r.subject = pending) && r.approved &&
  Certificate.check (context current) current.statement pending.artifact.proof

theorem validate_iff (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt) :
    validate i t r = true ↔
      t.artifact.identity = i ∧ r.subject = t ∧ r.approved = true ∧
      Certificate.check (context i) i.statement t.artifact.proof = true := by
  simp only [validate, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, h₃⟩, h₄⟩; exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄⟩; exact ⟨⟨⟨h₁,h₂⟩,h₃⟩,h₄⟩

theorem validated_identity (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) : t.artifact.identity = i := (validate_iff i t r).1 h |>.1

theorem validated_receipt (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) : r.subject = t := (validate_iff i t r).1 h |>.2.1

theorem validated_proof (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) :
    Certificate.check (context i) i.statement t.artifact.proof = true :=
  (validate_iff i t r).1 h |>.2.2.2

theorem validated_sound (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v (context i)) :
    Denote v i.statement := Certificate.check_sound _ _ _ (validated_proof i t r h) v hc

theorem validated_artifact_valid (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) : Valid t.artifact := by
  intro v hc
  have heq := validated_identity i t r h
  simpa only [heq] using (validated_sound i t r h v (by simpa only [heq] using hc))

theorem stale_identity_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity ≠ i) : validate i t r = false := by simp [validate, h]

theorem substituted_ticket_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : r.subject ≠ t) : validate i t r = false := by simp [validate, h]

theorem failed_proof_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : Certificate.check (context i) i.statement t.artifact.proof = false) :
    validate i t r = false := by simp [validate, h]

theorem generation_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : r.subject.generation ≠ t.generation) : validate i t r = false :=
  substituted_ticket_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Ticket.generation he))

theorem proof_bytes_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : r.subject.artifact.sourceBytes ≠ t.artifact.sourceBytes) :
    validate i t r = false :=
  substituted_ticket_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg (fun t => t.artifact.sourceBytes) he))

theorem target_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity.statement ≠ i.statement) : validate i t r = false :=
  stale_identity_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Identity.statement he))

theorem environment_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity.environment ≠ i.environment) : validate i t r = false :=
  stale_identity_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Identity.environment he))

theorem dependency_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity.dependencies ≠ i.dependencies) : validate i t r = false :=
  stale_identity_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Identity.dependencies he))

structure Slot where
  nextGeneration : Nat
  pending : Option Ticket
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def register (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) : Slot :=
  ⟨s.nextGeneration + 1, some ⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩⟩

def WellFormed (s : Slot) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, s.pending = some t → t.generation < s.nextGeneration

/-- A failed validation leaves the pending candidate untouched; success consumes it. -/
def consume (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) : Slot × Option Ticket :=
  match s.pending with
  | none => (s, none)
  | some t => if validate i t r then (⟨s.nextGeneration, none⟩, some t) else (s, none)

theorem register_pending (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) :
    (register s a).pending = some ⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩ := rfl

theorem register_wellFormed (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) : WellFormed (register s a) := by
  intro t ht
  have he : (⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩ : Ticket) = t := Option.some.inj ht
  subst t
  exact Nat.lt_succ_self _

theorem admission_iff (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket) :
    (consume s i r).2 = some t ↔ s.pending = some t ∧ validate i t r = true := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simp [consume, hp]
  | some u =>
      by_cases he : u = t
      · subst t
        by_cases hv : validate i u r = true <;> simp [consume, hp, hv]
      · by_cases hv : validate i u r = true <;> simp [consume, hp, he, hv]

theorem admission_consumes (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = some t) : (consume s i r).1.pending = none := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hv⟩ := (admission_iff s i r t).1 h
  simp [consume, hp, hv]

theorem admission_sound (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = some t) : Valid t.artifact :=
  validated_artifact_valid i t r ((admission_iff s i r t).1 h).2

theorem no_pending_no_admission (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt)
    (h : s.pending = none) : (consume s i r).2 = none := by simp [consume, h]

theorem successful_receipt_not_replayable (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = some t) : (consume (consume s i r).1 i r).2 = none :=
  no_pending_no_admission _ i r (admission_consumes s i r t h)

theorem old_pending_rejected_after_register (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) (i : Identity)
    (r : Receipt) (hs : WellFormed s) (hr : s.pending = some r.subject) :
    (consume (register s a) i r).2 = none := by
  have hlt := hs _ hr
  have hne : r.subject.generation ≠ s.nextGeneration := Nat.ne_of_lt hlt
  have hv := generation_mismatch_rejected i ⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩ r hne
  simp [consume, register, hv]

theorem consume_preserves_generation (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) :
    (consume s i r).1.nextGeneration = s.nextGeneration := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simp [consume, hp]
  | some t => by_cases hv : validate i t r = true <;> simp [consume, hp, hv]

theorem rejected_admission_unchanged (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = none) : (consume s i r).1 = s := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simp [consume, hp]
  | some t =>
      by_cases hv : validate i t r = true
      · simp [consume, hp, hv] at h
      · simp [consume, hp, hv]

theorem consume_preserves_wellFormed (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt)
    (hs : WellFormed s) : WellFormed (consume s i r).1 := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simpa [consume, hp] using hs
  | some t =>
      by_cases hv : validate i t r = true
      · intro u hu
        simp [consume, hp, hv] at hu
      · simpa [consume, hp, hv] using hs

end Komorebi.AVOC.Binding

import AVOC.ArtifactBinding

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Binding
open Lean Certificate

/-- Wire format uses explicit arrays and exact source strings. Its dependency
formulas are provided by the orchestrator after recursively checking their
snapshots. That filesystem connection remains a stated trusted boundary. -/
def parseDependency (j : Json) : Except String Dependency := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [name, statement, bytes] =>
      return ⟨← name.getStr?, ← parseFormula 64 statement, ← bytes.getStr?⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid dependency record"

def parseEnvironmentItem (j : Json) : Except String (String × String) := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [name, bytes] => return (← name.getStr?, ← bytes.getStr?)
  | _ => .error "invalid environment record"

def parseIdentity (j : Json) : Except String Identity := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [task, statement, bytes, .arr deps, .arr env] =>
      return ⟨← task.getStr?, ← parseFormula 64 statement, ← bytes.getStr?,
        ← deps.toList.mapM parseDependency, ← env.toList.mapM parseEnvironmentItem⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid identity record"

/-- The proof object is obtained from the exact source string held in the artifact. -/
def artifactFromSource (i : Identity) (bytes : String) : Except String Artifact :=
  match Json.parse bytes with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok j => match parseDerivation 128 j with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok p => .ok ⟨i, bytes, p⟩

theorem source_artifact_consistent (i : Identity) (bytes : String) (a : Artifact)
    (h : artifactFromSource i bytes = .ok a) :
    a.identity = i ∧ a.sourceBytes = bytes ∧
      ∃ j, Json.parse bytes = .ok j ∧ parseDerivation 128 j = .ok a.proof := by
  cases hj : Json.parse bytes with
  | error e => simp [artifactFromSource, hj] at h
  | ok j =>
      cases hp : parseDerivation 128 j with
      | error e => simp [artifactFromSource, hj, hp] at h
      | ok p =>
          have he : (⟨i,bytes,p⟩ : Artifact) = a := by simpa [artifactFromSource, hj, hp] using h
          subst a
          exact ⟨rfl,rfl,j,rfl,hp⟩

theorem source_artifact_checked_sound (i : Identity) (bytes : String) (a : Artifact)
    (h : artifactFromSource i bytes = .ok a)
    (hc : Certificate.check (context i) i.statement a.proof = true) :
    a.sourceBytes = bytes ∧ ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v (context i) → Denote v i.statement :=
  ⟨(source_artifact_consistent i bytes a h).2.1,
    fun v hv => Certificate.check_sound _ _ _ hc v hv⟩

def parseArtifact (j : Json) : Except String Artifact := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [identity, source] =>
      let i ← parseIdentity identity
      let bytes ← source.getStr?
      artifactFromSource i bytes
  | _ => .error "invalid artifact record"

def parseTicket (j : Json) : Except String Ticket := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [generation, artifact] => return ⟨← generation.getNat?, ← parseArtifact artifact⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid ticket"

def parseSlot (j : Json) : Except String Slot := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [next, .null] => return ⟨← next.getNat?, none⟩
  | [next, ticket] => return ⟨← next.getNat?, some (← parseTicket ticket)⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid slot"

def parseReceipt (j : Json) : Except String Receipt := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [ticket, .bool approved] => return ⟨← parseTicket ticket, approved⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid receipt"

def parseBoundRequest (j : Json) : Except String (Identity × Slot × Receipt) := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [.str "bound", identity, slot, receipt] =>
      return (← parseIdentity identity, ← parseSlot slot, ← parseReceipt receipt)
  | _ => .error "invalid binding request"

def checkBoundJson (j : Json) : Except String Bool :=
  match parseBoundRequest j with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok (i,s,r) => .ok ((consume s i r).2.isSome)

/-- The executed binding gate has both an exact pending subject and a sound
proof at every successful parse/check result. -/
theorem accepted_bound_json_has_evidence (j : Json) (h : checkBoundJson j = .ok true) :
    ∃ i s r t, parseBoundRequest j = .ok (i,s,r) ∧
      s.pending = some t ∧ r.subject = t ∧ t.artifact.identity = i ∧ Valid t.artifact := by
  cases hp : parseBoundRequest j with
  | error e => simp [checkBoundJson, hp] at h
  | ok data =>
      rcases data with ⟨i,s,r⟩
      have ha : (consume s i r).2.isSome = true := by simpa [checkBoundJson, hp] using h
      cases he : (consume s i r).2 with
      | none => simp [he] at ha
      | some t =>
          have hh := (admission_iff s i r t).1 he
          exact ⟨i,s,r,t,rfl,hh.1,validated_receipt i t r hh.2,
            validated_identity i t r hh.2,validated_artifact_valid i t r hh.2⟩

end Komorebi.AVOC.Binding

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Certificate
open Lean

/-- Bounded, data-only decoding. This parser is part of the implementation trust
boundary; infer_sound applies to its resulting syntax objects. -/
def parseFormula : Nat → Json → Except String Formula
  | 0, _ => .error "formula depth limit"
  | n + 1, .arr a => match a.toList with
      | [.str "atom", k] => return .atom (← k.getNat?)
      | [.str "true"] => return .truth
      | [.str "false"] => return .falsity
      | [.str "and", p, q] => return .conj (← parseFormula n p) (← parseFormula n q)
      | [.str "or", p, q] => return .disj (← parseFormula n p) (← parseFormula n q)
      | [.str "imp", p, q] => return .impl (← parseFormula n p) (← parseFormula n q)
      | _ => .error "invalid formula tag or arity"
  | _, _ => .error "formula must be an array"

def parseDerivation : Nat → Json → Except String Derivation
  | 0, _ => .error "proof depth limit"
  | n + 1, .arr a => match a.toList with
      | [.str "hyp", f] => return .use (← parseFormula 64 f)
      | [.str "true"] => return .truth
      | [.str "pair", p, q] => return .pair (← parseDerivation n p) (← parseDerivation n q)
      | [.str "fst", p] => return .first (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "snd", p] => return .second (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "intro", f, p] => return .abstract (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "mp", p, q] => return .apply (← parseDerivation n p) (← parseDerivation n q)
      | [.str "left", f, p] => return .left (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "right", f, p] => return .right (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "cases", p, q, r] => return .cases (← parseDerivation n p) (← parseDerivation n q) (← parseDerivation n r)
      | [.str "absurd", f, p] => return .absurd (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | _ => .error "invalid proof tag or arity"
  | _, _ => .error "proof must be an array"

def parseRequest (j : Json) : Except String (Formula × List Formula × Derivation) := do
  let a ← j.getArr?
  match a.toList with
  | [target, .arr ctx, proof] =>
      let t ← parseFormula 64 target
      let c ← ctx.toList.mapM (parseFormula 64)
      let p ← parseDerivation 128 proof
      return (t, c, p)
  | _ => .error "expected [target, context-array, proof]"

def checkJson (j : Json) : Except String Bool :=
  match parseRequest j with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok (t,c,p) => .ok (check c t p)

/-- The exact decoded sequent behind any accepted JSON request is sound. -/
theorem accepted_json_has_sound_sequent (j : Json) (h : checkJson j = .ok true) :
    ∃ t c p, parseRequest j = .ok (t,c,p) ∧
      ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v c → Denote v t := by
  cases hp : parseRequest j with
  | error e => simp [checkJson, hp] at h
  | ok data =>
      rcases data with ⟨t,c,p⟩
      have hc : check c t p = true := by simpa [checkJson, hp] using h
      exact ⟨t,c,p,rfl,fun v hs => check_sound c t p hc v hs⟩

end Komorebi.AVOC.Certificate

import Std

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Certificate

/-- A deliberately small, data-only intuitionistic propositional language. -/
inductive Formula where
  | atom : Nat → Formula
  | truth : Formula
  | falsity : Formula
  | conj : Formula → Formula → Formula
  | disj : Formula → Formula → Formula
  | impl : Formula → Formula → Formula
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Atoms can denote arbitrary Lean propositions, not merely Boolean constants. -/
def Denote (v : Nat → Prop) : Formula → Prop
  | .atom n => v n
  | .truth => True
  | .falsity => False
  | .conj p q => Denote v p ∧ Denote v q
  | .disj p q => Denote v p ∨ Denote v q
  | .impl p q => Denote v p → Denote v q

def Satisfies (v : Nat → Prop) (ctx : List Formula) : Prop :=
  ∀ f ∈ ctx, Denote v f

/-- Proof syntax is data. No tactics, imports, macros, IO, or external code occur. -/
inductive Derivation where
  | use : Formula → Derivation
  | truth : Derivation
  | pair : Derivation → Derivation → Derivation
  | first : Derivation → Derivation
  | second : Derivation → Derivation
  | abstract : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  | apply : Derivation → Derivation → Derivation
  | left : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  | right : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  | cases : Derivation → Derivation → Derivation → Derivation
  | absurd : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def infer (ctx : List Formula) : Derivation → Option Formula
  | .use f => if f ∈ ctx then some f else none
  | .truth => some .truth
  | .pair p q => match infer ctx p, infer ctx q with
      | some f, some g => some (.conj f g)
      | _, _ => none
  | .first p => match infer ctx p with
      | some (.conj f _) => some f
      | _ => none
  | .second p => match infer ctx p with
      | some (.conj _ g) => some g
      | _ => none
  | .abstract f p => match infer (f :: ctx) p with
      | some g => some (.impl f g)
      | _ => none
  | .apply p q => match infer ctx p, infer ctx q with
      | some (.impl f g), some f' => if f = f' then some g else none
      | _, _ => none
  | .left g p => match infer ctx p with
      | some f => some (.disj f g)
      | _ => none
  | .right f p => match infer ctx p with
      | some g => some (.disj f g)
      | _ => none
  | .cases p q r => match infer ctx p with
      | some (.disj f g) => match infer (f :: ctx) q, infer (g :: ctx) r with
          | some h, some h' => if h = h' then some h else none
          | _, _ => none
      | _ => none
  | .absurd f p => match infer ctx p with
      | some .falsity => some f
      | _ => none

def check (ctx : List Formula) (target : Formula) (proof : Derivation) : Bool :=
  decide (infer ctx proof = some target)

theorem satisfies_cons (v : Nat → Prop) (ctx : List Formula) (f : Formula)
    (hf : Denote v f) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) : Satisfies v (f :: ctx) := by
  intro g hg
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hg with h | h
  · subst g; exact hf
  · exact hc g h

/-- Soundness is proved for the executable inference function itself. -/
theorem infer_sound (proof : Derivation) (ctx : List Formula) (target : Formula)
    (hi : infer ctx proof = some target) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) :
    Denote v target := by
  induction proof generalizing ctx target with
  | use f =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact hc _ ‹_›
      · contradiction
  | truth => cases hi; trivial
  | pair p q ihp ihq =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact ⟨ihp _ _ ‹_› hc, ihq _ _ ‹_› hc⟩
      · contradiction
  | first p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact (ih _ (.conj _ _) ‹_› hc).1
      · contradiction
  | second p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact (ih _ (.conj _ _) ‹_› hc).2
      · contradiction
  | abstract f p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi
        intro hf
        exact ih _ _ ‹_› (satisfies_cons v ctx f hf hc)
      · contradiction
  | apply p q ihp ihq =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · split at hi
        · rename_i heq
          subst heq
          cases hi
          exact (ihp _ (.impl _ _) ‹_› hc) (ihq _ _ ‹_› hc)
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
  | left g p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact Or.inl (ih _ _ ‹_› hc)
      · contradiction
  | right f p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact Or.inr (ih _ _ ‹_› hc)
      · contradiction
  | cases p q r ihp ihq ihr =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · split at hi
        · split at hi
          · rename_i heq
            subst heq
            cases hi
            rcases ihp _ (.disj _ _) ‹_› hc with hf | hg
            · exact ihq _ _ ‹_› (satisfies_cons v ctx _ hf hc)
            · exact ihr _ _ ‹_› (satisfies_cons v ctx _ hg hc)
          · contradiction
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
  | absurd f p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · exact False.elim (ih _ .falsity ‹_› hc)
      · contradiction

theorem check_sound (ctx : List Formula) (target : Formula) (proof : Derivation)
    (h : check ctx target proof = true) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) :
    Denote v target :=
  infer_sound proof ctx target (of_decide_eq_true h) v hc

theorem no_closed_false_proof (proof : Derivation) : check [] .falsity proof = false := by
  cases h : check [] .falsity proof with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
      have bad := check_sound [] .falsity proof h (fun _ => False)
        (by intro f hf; simp at hf)
      exact False.elim bad

theorem identity_checked (f : Formula) :
    check [] (.impl f f) (.abstract f (.use f)) = true := by
  simp [check, infer]

theorem premise_checked (ctx : List Formula) (f : Formula) (h : f ∈ ctx) :
    check ctx f (.use f) = true := by simp [check, infer, h]

theorem truth_checked (ctx : List Formula) : check ctx .truth .truth = true := rfl

theorem check_target_unique (ctx : List Formula) (p : Derivation) (f g : Formula)
    (hf : check ctx f p = true) (hg : check ctx g p = true) : f = g := by
  have h := (of_decide_eq_true hf).symm.trans (of_decide_eq_true hg)
  exact Option.some.inj h

/-- Sequential closure of a list of checked artifacts. Later claims can use only
already certified formulas, never a future or circular premise. -/
def CheckedChain : List Formula → List (Formula × Derivation) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | ctx, (f,p) :: rest => check ctx f p = true ∧ CheckedChain (f :: ctx) rest

def chainContext : List Formula → List (Formula × Derivation) → List Formula
  | ctx, [] => ctx
  | ctx, (f,_) :: rest => chainContext (f :: ctx) rest

theorem checked_chain_sound (ctx : List Formula) (xs : List (Formula × Derivation))
    (h : CheckedChain ctx xs) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) :
    Satisfies v (chainContext ctx xs) := by
  induction xs generalizing ctx with
  | nil => exact hc
  | cons item xs ih =>
      rcases item with ⟨f,p⟩
      exact ih _ h.2 (satisfies_cons v ctx f (check_sound ctx f p h.1 v hc) hc)

theorem closed_chain_sound (xs : List (Formula × Derivation))
    (h : CheckedChain [] xs) : ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v (chainContext [] xs) := by
  intro v
  exact checked_chain_sound [] xs h v (by intro f hf; simp at hf)

import AVOC.CertificateLogic

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Binding

open Certificate

/-- Dependencies bind their declared formula and the exact retained artifact bytes. -/
structure Dependency where
  name : String
  statement : Formula
  artifactBytes : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Formal meaning and execution identity. Strings denote full byte snapshots in
this model, never an axiom that a finite hash is injective. -/
structure Identity where
  task : String
  statement : Formula
  statementBytes : String
  dependencies : List Dependency
  environment : List (String × String)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Artifact where
  identity : Identity
  sourceBytes : String
  proof : Derivation
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Generation distinguishes re-registration even of exactly the same payload. -/
structure Ticket where
  generation : Nat
  artifact : Artifact
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Receipt where
  subject : Ticket
  approved : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def context (i : Identity) : List Formula := i.dependencies.map Dependency.statement

def Valid (a : Artifact) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v (context a.identity) → Denote v a.identity.statement

/-- A persisted receipt is not trusted as proof. The data-only proof is rechecked. -/
def validate (current : Identity) (pending : Ticket) (r : Receipt) : Bool :=
  decide (pending.artifact.identity = current) &&
  decide (r.subject = pending) && r.approved &&
  Certificate.check (context current) current.statement pending.artifact.proof

theorem validate_iff (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt) :
    validate i t r = true ↔
      t.artifact.identity = i ∧ r.subject = t ∧ r.approved = true ∧
      Certificate.check (context i) i.statement t.artifact.proof = true := by
  simp only [validate, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, h₃⟩, h₄⟩; exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄⟩; exact ⟨⟨⟨h₁,h₂⟩,h₃⟩,h₄⟩

theorem validated_identity (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) : t.artifact.identity = i := (validate_iff i t r).1 h |>.1

theorem validated_receipt (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) : r.subject = t := (validate_iff i t r).1 h |>.2.1

theorem validated_proof (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) :
    Certificate.check (context i) i.statement t.artifact.proof = true :=
  (validate_iff i t r).1 h |>.2.2.2

theorem validated_sound (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v (context i)) :
    Denote v i.statement := Certificate.check_sound _ _ _ (validated_proof i t r h) v hc

theorem validated_artifact_valid (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : validate i t r = true) : Valid t.artifact := by
  intro v hc
  have heq := validated_identity i t r h
  simpa only [heq] using (validated_sound i t r h v (by simpa only [heq] using hc))

theorem stale_identity_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity ≠ i) : validate i t r = false := by simp [validate, h]

theorem substituted_ticket_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : r.subject ≠ t) : validate i t r = false := by simp [validate, h]

theorem failed_proof_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : Certificate.check (context i) i.statement t.artifact.proof = false) :
    validate i t r = false := by simp [validate, h]

theorem generation_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : r.subject.generation ≠ t.generation) : validate i t r = false :=
  substituted_ticket_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Ticket.generation he))

theorem proof_bytes_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : r.subject.artifact.sourceBytes ≠ t.artifact.sourceBytes) :
    validate i t r = false :=
  substituted_ticket_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg (fun t => t.artifact.sourceBytes) he))

theorem target_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity.statement ≠ i.statement) : validate i t r = false :=
  stale_identity_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Identity.statement he))

theorem environment_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity.environment ≠ i.environment) : validate i t r = false :=
  stale_identity_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Identity.environment he))

theorem dependency_mismatch_rejected (i : Identity) (t : Ticket) (r : Receipt)
    (h : t.artifact.identity.dependencies ≠ i.dependencies) : validate i t r = false :=
  stale_identity_rejected i t r (fun he => h (congrArg Identity.dependencies he))

structure Slot where
  nextGeneration : Nat
  pending : Option Ticket
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def register (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) : Slot :=
  ⟨s.nextGeneration + 1, some ⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩⟩

def WellFormed (s : Slot) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, s.pending = some t → t.generation < s.nextGeneration

/-- A failed validation leaves the pending candidate untouched; success consumes it. -/
def consume (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) : Slot × Option Ticket :=
  match s.pending with
  | none => (s, none)
  | some t => if validate i t r then (⟨s.nextGeneration, none⟩, some t) else (s, none)

theorem register_pending (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) :
    (register s a).pending = some ⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩ := rfl

theorem register_wellFormed (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) : WellFormed (register s a) := by
  intro t ht
  have he : (⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩ : Ticket) = t := Option.some.inj ht
  subst t
  exact Nat.lt_succ_self _

theorem admission_iff (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket) :
    (consume s i r).2 = some t ↔ s.pending = some t ∧ validate i t r = true := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simp [consume, hp]
  | some u =>
      by_cases he : u = t
      · subst t
        by_cases hv : validate i u r = true <;> simp [consume, hp, hv]
      · by_cases hv : validate i u r = true <;> simp [consume, hp, he, hv]

theorem admission_consumes (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = some t) : (consume s i r).1.pending = none := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hv⟩ := (admission_iff s i r t).1 h
  simp [consume, hp, hv]

theorem admission_sound (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = some t) : Valid t.artifact :=
  validated_artifact_valid i t r ((admission_iff s i r t).1 h).2

theorem no_pending_no_admission (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt)
    (h : s.pending = none) : (consume s i r).2 = none := by simp [consume, h]

theorem successful_receipt_not_replayable (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) (t : Ticket)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = some t) : (consume (consume s i r).1 i r).2 = none :=
  no_pending_no_admission _ i r (admission_consumes s i r t h)

theorem old_pending_rejected_after_register (s : Slot) (a : Artifact) (i : Identity)
    (r : Receipt) (hs : WellFormed s) (hr : s.pending = some r.subject) :
    (consume (register s a) i r).2 = none := by
  have hlt := hs _ hr
  have hne : r.subject.generation ≠ s.nextGeneration := Nat.ne_of_lt hlt
  have hv := generation_mismatch_rejected i ⟨s.nextGeneration, a⟩ r hne
  simp [consume, register, hv]

theorem consume_preserves_generation (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt) :
    (consume s i r).1.nextGeneration = s.nextGeneration := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simp [consume, hp]
  | some t => by_cases hv : validate i t r = true <;> simp [consume, hp, hv]

theorem rejected_admission_unchanged (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt)
    (h : (consume s i r).2 = none) : (consume s i r).1 = s := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simp [consume, hp]
  | some t =>
      by_cases hv : validate i t r = true
      · simp [consume, hp, hv] at h
      · simp [consume, hp, hv]

theorem consume_preserves_wellFormed (s : Slot) (i : Identity) (r : Receipt)
    (hs : WellFormed s) : WellFormed (consume s i r).1 := by
  cases hp : s.pending with
  | none => simpa [consume, hp] using hs
  | some t =>
      by_cases hv : validate i t r = true
      · intro u hu
        simp [consume, hp, hv] at hu
      · simpa [consume, hp, hv] using hs

end Komorebi.AVOC.Binding

import AVOC.ArtifactBinding

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Binding
open Lean Certificate

/-- Wire format uses explicit arrays and exact source strings. Its dependency
formulas are provided by the orchestrator after recursively checking their
snapshots. That filesystem connection remains a stated trusted boundary. -/
def parseDependency (j : Json) : Except String Dependency := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [name, statement, bytes] =>
      return ⟨← name.getStr?, ← parseFormula 64 statement, ← bytes.getStr?⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid dependency record"

def parseEnvironmentItem (j : Json) : Except String (String × String) := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [name, bytes] => return (← name.getStr?, ← bytes.getStr?)
  | _ => .error "invalid environment record"

def parseIdentity (j : Json) : Except String Identity := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [task, statement, bytes, .arr deps, .arr env] =>
      return ⟨← task.getStr?, ← parseFormula 64 statement, ← bytes.getStr?,
        ← deps.toList.mapM parseDependency, ← env.toList.mapM parseEnvironmentItem⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid identity record"

/-- The proof object is obtained from the exact source string held in the artifact. -/
def artifactFromSource (i : Identity) (bytes : String) : Except String Artifact :=
  match Json.parse bytes with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok j => match parseDerivation 128 j with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok p => .ok ⟨i, bytes, p⟩

theorem source_artifact_consistent (i : Identity) (bytes : String) (a : Artifact)
    (h : artifactFromSource i bytes = .ok a) :
    a.identity = i ∧ a.sourceBytes = bytes ∧
      ∃ j, Json.parse bytes = .ok j ∧ parseDerivation 128 j = .ok a.proof := by
  cases hj : Json.parse bytes with
  | error e => simp [artifactFromSource, hj] at h
  | ok j =>
      cases hp : parseDerivation 128 j with
      | error e => simp [artifactFromSource, hj, hp] at h
      | ok p =>
          have he : (⟨i,bytes,p⟩ : Artifact) = a := by simpa [artifactFromSource, hj, hp] using h
          subst a
          exact ⟨rfl,rfl,j,rfl,hp⟩

theorem source_artifact_checked_sound (i : Identity) (bytes : String) (a : Artifact)
    (h : artifactFromSource i bytes = .ok a)
    (hc : Certificate.check (context i) i.statement a.proof = true) :
    a.sourceBytes = bytes ∧ ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v (context i) → Denote v i.statement :=
  ⟨(source_artifact_consistent i bytes a h).2.1,
    fun v hv => Certificate.check_sound _ _ _ hc v hv⟩

def parseArtifact (j : Json) : Except String Artifact := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [identity, source] =>
      let i ← parseIdentity identity
      let bytes ← source.getStr?
      artifactFromSource i bytes
  | _ => .error "invalid artifact record"

def parseTicket (j : Json) : Except String Ticket := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [generation, artifact] => return ⟨← generation.getNat?, ← parseArtifact artifact⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid ticket"

def parseSlot (j : Json) : Except String Slot := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [next, .null] => return ⟨← next.getNat?, none⟩
  | [next, ticket] => return ⟨← next.getNat?, some (← parseTicket ticket)⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid slot"

def parseReceipt (j : Json) : Except String Receipt := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [ticket, .bool approved] => return ⟨← parseTicket ticket, approved⟩
  | _ => .error "invalid receipt"

def parseBoundRequest (j : Json) : Except String (Identity × Slot × Receipt) := do
  match (← j.getArr?).toList with
  | [.str "bound", identity, slot, receipt] =>
      return (← parseIdentity identity, ← parseSlot slot, ← parseReceipt receipt)
  | _ => .error "invalid binding request"

def checkBoundJson (j : Json) : Except String Bool :=
  match parseBoundRequest j with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok (i,s,r) => .ok ((consume s i r).2.isSome)

/-- The executed binding gate has both an exact pending subject and a sound
proof at every successful parse/check result. -/
theorem accepted_bound_json_has_evidence (j : Json) (h : checkBoundJson j = .ok true) :
    ∃ i s r t, parseBoundRequest j = .ok (i,s,r) ∧
      s.pending = some t ∧ r.subject = t ∧ t.artifact.identity = i ∧ Valid t.artifact := by
  cases hp : parseBoundRequest j with
  | error e => simp [checkBoundJson, hp] at h
  | ok data =>
      rcases data with ⟨i,s,r⟩
      have ha : (consume s i r).2.isSome = true := by simpa [checkBoundJson, hp] using h
      cases he : (consume s i r).2 with
      | none => simp [he] at ha
      | some t =>
          have hh := (admission_iff s i r t).1 he
          exact ⟨i,s,r,t,rfl,hh.1,validated_receipt i t r hh.2,
            validated_identity i t r hh.2,validated_artifact_valid i t r hh.2⟩

end Komorebi.AVOC.Binding

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Certificate
open Lean

/-- Bounded, data-only decoding. This parser is part of the implementation trust
boundary; infer_sound applies to its resulting syntax objects. -/
def parseFormula : Nat → Json → Except String Formula
  | 0, _ => .error "formula depth limit"
  | n + 1, .arr a => match a.toList with
      | [.str "atom", k] => return .atom (← k.getNat?)
      | [.str "true"] => return .truth
      | [.str "false"] => return .falsity
      | [.str "and", p, q] => return .conj (← parseFormula n p) (← parseFormula n q)
      | [.str "or", p, q] => return .disj (← parseFormula n p) (← parseFormula n q)
      | [.str "imp", p, q] => return .impl (← parseFormula n p) (← parseFormula n q)
      | _ => .error "invalid formula tag or arity"
  | _, _ => .error "formula must be an array"

def parseDerivation : Nat → Json → Except String Derivation
  | 0, _ => .error "proof depth limit"
  | n + 1, .arr a => match a.toList with
      | [.str "hyp", f] => return .use (← parseFormula 64 f)
      | [.str "true"] => return .truth
      | [.str "pair", p, q] => return .pair (← parseDerivation n p) (← parseDerivation n q)
      | [.str "fst", p] => return .first (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "snd", p] => return .second (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "intro", f, p] => return .abstract (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "mp", p, q] => return .apply (← parseDerivation n p) (← parseDerivation n q)
      | [.str "left", f, p] => return .left (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "right", f, p] => return .right (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | [.str "cases", p, q, r] => return .cases (← parseDerivation n p) (← parseDerivation n q) (← parseDerivation n r)
      | [.str "absurd", f, p] => return .absurd (← parseFormula 64 f) (← parseDerivation n p)
      | _ => .error "invalid proof tag or arity"
  | _, _ => .error "proof must be an array"

def parseRequest (j : Json) : Except String (Formula × List Formula × Derivation) := do
  let a ← j.getArr?
  match a.toList with
  | [target, .arr ctx, proof] =>
      let t ← parseFormula 64 target
      let c ← ctx.toList.mapM (parseFormula 64)
      let p ← parseDerivation 128 proof
      return (t, c, p)
  | _ => .error "expected [target, context-array, proof]"

def checkJson (j : Json) : Except String Bool :=
  match parseRequest j with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok (t,c,p) => .ok (check c t p)

/-- The exact decoded sequent behind any accepted JSON request is sound. -/
theorem accepted_json_has_sound_sequent (j : Json) (h : checkJson j = .ok true) :
    ∃ t c p, parseRequest j = .ok (t,c,p) ∧
      ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v c → Denote v t := by
  cases hp : parseRequest j with
  | error e => simp [checkJson, hp] at h
  | ok data =>
      rcases data with ⟨t,c,p⟩
      have hc : check c t p = true := by simpa [checkJson, hp] using h
      exact ⟨t,c,p,rfl,fun v hs => check_sound c t p hc v hs⟩

end Komorebi.AVOC.Certificate

import Std

namespace Komorebi.AVOC.Certificate

/-- A deliberately small, data-only intuitionistic propositional language. -/
inductive Formula where
  | atom : Nat → Formula
  | truth : Formula
  | falsity : Formula
  | conj : Formula → Formula → Formula
  | disj : Formula → Formula → Formula
  | impl : Formula → Formula → Formula
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Atoms can denote arbitrary Lean propositions, not merely Boolean constants. -/
def Denote (v : Nat → Prop) : Formula → Prop
  | .atom n => v n
  | .truth => True
  | .falsity => False
  | .conj p q => Denote v p ∧ Denote v q
  | .disj p q => Denote v p ∨ Denote v q
  | .impl p q => Denote v p → Denote v q

def Satisfies (v : Nat → Prop) (ctx : List Formula) : Prop :=
  ∀ f ∈ ctx, Denote v f

/-- Proof syntax is data. No tactics, imports, macros, IO, or external code occur. -/
inductive Derivation where
  | use : Formula → Derivation
  | truth : Derivation
  | pair : Derivation → Derivation → Derivation
  | first : Derivation → Derivation
  | second : Derivation → Derivation
  | abstract : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  | apply : Derivation → Derivation → Derivation
  | left : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  | right : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  | cases : Derivation → Derivation → Derivation → Derivation
  | absurd : Formula → Derivation → Derivation
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def infer (ctx : List Formula) : Derivation → Option Formula
  | .use f => if f ∈ ctx then some f else none
  | .truth => some .truth
  | .pair p q => match infer ctx p, infer ctx q with
      | some f, some g => some (.conj f g)
      | _, _ => none
  | .first p => match infer ctx p with
      | some (.conj f _) => some f
      | _ => none
  | .second p => match infer ctx p with
      | some (.conj _ g) => some g
      | _ => none
  | .abstract f p => match infer (f :: ctx) p with
      | some g => some (.impl f g)
      | _ => none
  | .apply p q => match infer ctx p, infer ctx q with
      | some (.impl f g), some f' => if f = f' then some g else none
      | _, _ => none
  | .left g p => match infer ctx p with
      | some f => some (.disj f g)
      | _ => none
  | .right f p => match infer ctx p with
      | some g => some (.disj f g)
      | _ => none
  | .cases p q r => match infer ctx p with
      | some (.disj f g) => match infer (f :: ctx) q, infer (g :: ctx) r with
          | some h, some h' => if h = h' then some h else none
          | _, _ => none
      | _ => none
  | .absurd f p => match infer ctx p with
      | some .falsity => some f
      | _ => none

def check (ctx : List Formula) (target : Formula) (proof : Derivation) : Bool :=
  decide (infer ctx proof = some target)

theorem satisfies_cons (v : Nat → Prop) (ctx : List Formula) (f : Formula)
    (hf : Denote v f) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) : Satisfies v (f :: ctx) := by
  intro g hg
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hg with h | h
  · subst g; exact hf
  · exact hc g h

/-- Soundness is proved for the executable inference function itself. -/
theorem infer_sound (proof : Derivation) (ctx : List Formula) (target : Formula)
    (hi : infer ctx proof = some target) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) :
    Denote v target := by
  induction proof generalizing ctx target with
  | use f =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact hc _ ‹_›
      · contradiction
  | truth => cases hi; trivial
  | pair p q ihp ihq =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact ⟨ihp _ _ ‹_› hc, ihq _ _ ‹_› hc⟩
      · contradiction
  | first p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact (ih _ (.conj _ _) ‹_› hc).1
      · contradiction
  | second p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact (ih _ (.conj _ _) ‹_› hc).2
      · contradiction
  | abstract f p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi
        intro hf
        exact ih _ _ ‹_› (satisfies_cons v ctx f hf hc)
      · contradiction
  | apply p q ihp ihq =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · split at hi
        · rename_i heq
          subst heq
          cases hi
          exact (ihp _ (.impl _ _) ‹_› hc) (ihq _ _ ‹_› hc)
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
  | left g p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact Or.inl (ih _ _ ‹_› hc)
      · contradiction
  | right f p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · cases hi; exact Or.inr (ih _ _ ‹_› hc)
      · contradiction
  | cases p q r ihp ihq ihr =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · split at hi
        · split at hi
          · rename_i heq
            subst heq
            cases hi
            rcases ihp _ (.disj _ _) ‹_› hc with hf | hg
            · exact ihq _ _ ‹_› (satisfies_cons v ctx _ hf hc)
            · exact ihr _ _ ‹_› (satisfies_cons v ctx _ hg hc)
          · contradiction
        · contradiction
      · contradiction
  | absurd f p ih =>
      simp only [infer] at hi
      split at hi
      · exact False.elim (ih _ .falsity ‹_› hc)
      · contradiction

theorem check_sound (ctx : List Formula) (target : Formula) (proof : Derivation)
    (h : check ctx target proof = true) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) :
    Denote v target :=
  infer_sound proof ctx target (of_decide_eq_true h) v hc

theorem no_closed_false_proof (proof : Derivation) : check [] .falsity proof = false := by
  cases h : check [] .falsity proof with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
      have bad := check_sound [] .falsity proof h (fun _ => False)
        (by intro f hf; simp at hf)
      exact False.elim bad

theorem identity_checked (f : Formula) :
    check [] (.impl f f) (.abstract f (.use f)) = true := by
  simp [check, infer]

theorem premise_checked (ctx : List Formula) (f : Formula) (h : f ∈ ctx) :
    check ctx f (.use f) = true := by simp [check, infer, h]

theorem truth_checked (ctx : List Formula) : check ctx .truth .truth = true := rfl

theorem check_target_unique (ctx : List Formula) (p : Derivation) (f g : Formula)
    (hf : check ctx f p = true) (hg : check ctx g p = true) : f = g := by
  have h := (of_decide_eq_true hf).symm.trans (of_decide_eq_true hg)
  exact Option.some.inj h

/-- Sequential closure of a list of checked artifacts. Later claims can use only
already certified formulas, never a future or circular premise. -/
def CheckedChain : List Formula → List (Formula × Derivation) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | ctx, (f,p) :: rest => check ctx f p = true ∧ CheckedChain (f :: ctx) rest

def chainContext : List Formula → List (Formula × Derivation) → List Formula
  | ctx, [] => ctx
  | ctx, (f,_) :: rest => chainContext (f :: ctx) rest

theorem checked_chain_sound (ctx : List Formula) (xs : List (Formula × Derivation))
    (h : CheckedChain ctx xs) (v : Nat → Prop) (hc : Satisfies v ctx) :
    Satisfies v (chainContext ctx xs) := by
  induction xs generalizing ctx with
  | nil => exact hc
  | cons item xs ih =>
      rcases item with ⟨f,p⟩
      exact ih _ h.2 (satisfies_cons v ctx f (check_sound ctx f p h.1 v hc) hc)

theorem closed_chain_sound (xs : List (Formula × Derivation))
    (h : CheckedChain [] xs) : ∀ v : Nat → Prop, Satisfies v (chainContext [] xs) := by
  intro v
  exact checked_chain_sound [] xs h v (by intro f hf; simp at hf)

  let [path] := args | do
    IO.eprintln "usage: CertificateMain request.json"

    IO.eprintln "input byte limit exceeded"
    return 2

    let j ← Lean.Json.parse input

    if a.size = 4 then
      Komorebi.AVOC.Binding.checkBoundJson j
    else
      Komorebi.AVOC.Certificate.checkJson j
  match result with
  | .error e =>
      IO.eprintln e
      return 2

      IO.println "{\"accepted\":false}"
      return 1

      IO.println "{\"accepted\":true}"
      return 0
